cond_0001.intro:
Dr. Sayaka Inoue's lab is seeking a motivated technician with lab experience to conduct research projects and assist with research activities at [Company name masked]. Our lab is focused on understanding the molecular and circuit mechanisms underlying hormone-dependent changes in behaviors, aiming to understand the etiology of women's neuropsychiatric symptoms related to premenstrual syndrome, premenstrual dysphoric disorder, and menopausal syndrome. We utilize mouse molecular systems and neuroscience techniques.
This position assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment. Maintains files on research and assists with data entry. Maintains animal colony including genotyping. Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning. Assures compliance with University policies, procedures, and regulations. Performs other duties as assigned.
Works in laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological, chemical and laser hazards. Must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in biology or related science field
Lab experience
Effective verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
Ability to work independently with strong critical thinking and attention to detail
Ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports
Bachelor's degree and up to 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years
Preferred Requirements
Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment
Ability to be highly productive in a collaborative work environment
All external candidates receiving an offer for employment will be required to submit to pre-employment screening for this position. The screenings will include criminal background check and, as applicable for the position, other background checks, drug screen, an employment and education or licensure/certification verification, physical examination, certain vaccinations and/or governmental registry checks. All offers are contingent upon successful completion of required screening.

Ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports

Ability to contribute actively in a collaborative work environment

Our lab is focused on understanding the molecular and circuit mechanisms underlying hormone-dependent changes in behaviors, aiming to understand the etiology of women's neuropsychiatric symptoms related to premenstrual syndrome, premenstrual dysphoric disorder, and menopausal syndrome. We utilize mouse molecular systems and neuroscience techniques.
This position assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with molecular and neuroscience lab work.
cond_0158.responsibilities:
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment. Maintains files on research and assists with data entry. Maintains animal colony including genotyping. Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning. Assures compliance with University policies, procedures, and regulations. Performs other duties as assigned.
Works in laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological, chemical and laser hazards. Must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
cond_0158.requirements: Bachelor's degree in biology or related science field. Lab experience. Effective verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to work independently with strong critical thinking and attention to detail. Ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports. Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment. Ability to be highly productive in a collaborative work environment. Bachelor's degree and up to 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.

Bachelor's degree in biology or related science field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.

Strong command of record-keeping practices, with the ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports.

Significant ability to work independently, with strong critical thinking and attention to detail.

Performs other duties as assigned.

Our lab is focused on understanding the molecular and circuit mechanisms underlying hormone-dependent changes in behaviors, aiming to understand the etiology of women's neuropsychiatric symptoms related to premenstrual syndrome, premenstrual dysphoric disorder, and menopausal syndrome. We utilize mouse molecular systems and neuroscience techniques.
This position assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the molecular and neuroscience work involved.
cond_0319.responsibilities:
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment. Maintains files on research and assists with data entry. Maintains animal colony including genotyping. Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning. Assures compliance with University policies, procedures, and regulations. Performs other duties as assigned.
Works in laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological, chemical and laser hazards. Must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
cond_0319.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in biology or related science field. Lab experience. Effective verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to work independently with strong critical thinking and attention to detail. Ability to maintain complete and organized records/reports. Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment. Ability to be highly productive in a collaborative work environment. Bachelor's degree and up to 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting; or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.
All external candidates receiving an offer for employment will be required to submit to pre-employment screening for this position. The screenings will include criminal background check and, as applicable for the position, other background checks, drug screen, an employment and education or licensure/certification verification, physical examination, certain vaccinations and/or governmental registry checks. All offers are contingent upon successful completion of required screening.

Dr. Sayaka Inoue's lab is looking for a technician to work alongside the team on research projects at [Company name masked]. Our lab focuses on understanding the molecular and circuit mechanisms underlying hormone-dependent changes in behaviors, with the aim of understanding the etiology of women's neuropsychiatric symptoms related to premenstrual syndrome, premenstrual dysphoric disorder, and menopausal syndrome. This position supports the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.

Coordinate on general lab maintenance and cleaning.
Help ensure compliance with University policies, procedures, and regulations.

Lab experience
Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills

Ability to work independently with strong critical thinking and attention to detail
Ability to be productive in a collaborative work environment

Our lab is focused on understanding the molecular and circuit mechanisms underlying hormone-dependent changes in behaviors, aiming to understand the etiology of women's neuropsychiatric symptoms related to premenstrual syndrome, premenstrual dysphoric disorder, and menopausal syndrome. We utilize mouse molecular systems and neuroscience techniques.
This position assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
cond_0444.responsibilities:
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment. Maintains files on research and assists with data entry. Maintains animal colony including genotyping. Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning. Assures compliance with University policies, procedures, and regulations. Performs other duties as assigned.
Works in laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological, chemical and laser hazards. Must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
cond_0444.requirements: Bachelor's degree in biology or related science field, or equivalent practical experience. Some lab experience is expected; around 1 year in a laboratory setting, or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years is welcome. Ability to communicate effectively in verbal, written, and interpersonal settings. Willingness to work independently and openness to developing critical thinking and attention to detail. Ability to maintain organized records and reports. Familiarity with computer software and general lab equipment. Ability to contribute productively in a collaborative work environment.

Our lab is focused on understanding the molecular and circuit mechanisms underlying hormone-dependent changes in behaviors, aiming to understand the etiology of women's neuropsychiatric symptoms related to premenstrual syndrome, premenstrual dysphoric disorder, and menopausal syndrome. We utilize mouse molecular systems and neuroscience techniques.
This position assists with the technical aspects of studies and experiments, including documentation and preparation of materials.
cond_0525.responsibilities:
Assists with research studies, experiments and assays, including collection of data, preparation of solutions and set-up and maintenance of equipment. Maintains files on research and assists with data entry. Maintains animal colony including genotyping. Assists with general lab maintenance and cleaning. Assures compliance with University policies, procedures, and regulations. Performs other duties as assigned.
Works in laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological, chemical and laser hazards. Must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.
cond_0525.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in biology or related science field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 1 year of experience in a laboratory setting, or an equivalent combination of education and experience equaling 4 years.
Working knowledge of computer software and general lab equipment.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with good interpersonal skills.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with maintaining complete and organized records and reports.
Ability to work independently with attention to detail and a willingness to develop critical thinking skills.
Comfort working collaboratively and contributing productively in a team environment.
All external candidates receiving an offer for employment will be required to submit to pre-employment screening for this position. The screenings will include criminal background check and, as applicable for the position, other background checks, drug screen, an employment and education or licensure/certification verification, physical examination, certain vaccinations and/or governmental registry checks. All offers are contingent upon successful completion of required screening.
cond_0525.workplace_support: We aim to support employees across different life and career stages through development resources, workplace flexibility, and inclusive benefits that make it easier to grow, contribute, and stay well.
